text:
QUOTE: Each spawned thread opens a `HandleLogScope` with the owning handle's `log_id` (`external_bridge.cpp:797`, `:946`). The log routing is `thread_local` (`src/types/logging.cpp:36`), so without this, lines from a worker would go to the wrong session log.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states that spawned threads open a per-handle log scope with the owning handle's log_id so worker logs route to the correct handle/session.
